column1: # NACA 0012, Re 6e6, M 0.15, transition fixed (grit at 0.05c both surfaces). Source: C.L. Ladson, NASA TM-4074 (1988), NTRS 19880019495, US Government work, public use permitted (NTRS: GOV_PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED); Tables IX (80 grit, R 5.95e6), XI (120 grit, R 6.00e6), XIII (180 grit, R 5.95e6). C_l from surface-pressure integration, C_d from wake survey; tunnel-wall corrections (Allen & Vincenti) applied by the source (~2 %). Derived by grok QA r20 (prereg 2c4380d): linear interpolation in alpha per grit, mean over grits. band_prereg = RSS(half grit range, |linear - nearest row|, repeatability C_l 0.004 / C_d 0.0002 from the report). band_posthoc replaces the nearest-row term with |linear - quadratic through 3 nearest rows| (post-hoc, see note). Raw table rows are not reproduced here.
